title: watches
prerequisites: Check v1.watches supported, enabled, granted and ready; execute only with all required authorization.

operations.summary: Call me back when ...: the phone reads the data you pick (location, motion, a camera photo, ...) on an interval, asks Clef or Jev (paid) your question about the last few readings, and calls you back when the answer matches. With a photo, a free change check on the phone skips the paid call while the picture stays the same; model none is local only. Designing one (which model, the change check, a worked door-camera example, cost): https://bridgit.cc/learn/decisions.md
Your running watches, with their last check
One running watch: its spec, the last 10 checks with the model's answers, and the last state sent
Stop a watch (you get a watch.ended event with reason deleted)
A tally watch's counts: today, the last 7 days, what's going on now, typical gaps, rules, and the episodes
Pause or resume your watch without losing its tally; expiry is unchanged
The library of common picture situations a watch can count (dog licking itself, pot boiling over, sunlight in the room, ...): send one as situation in POST /v1/watches, or describe your own in words

boundaries: Documented public API; owner switches, grants and runtime checks still apply.
